build_identification: Serving local build at 8766; project file timestamps observed 2026-11-02; app build number itself not independently exposed.
method: Isolated headless Chrome context (new browser.new_context; service workers blocked). Visible DOM text nodes are measured from computed foreground color and nearest ancestor solid background color. WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio formula is applied.

thresholds.large_text: 3.0 for >=24 CSS px regular or >=18.66 CSS px bold
thresholds.non_text: Not scored as text; controls and indicators are captured for review.

isolation: Fresh browser context, no existing browser profile or user database. App may initialize demo data in the ephemeral context only. No imports, edits, or submissions were performed.

limitations: Solid-color estimates are not reliable over gradients, background images, translucent overlays, blend modes, text shadows, or opacity stacking; flagged entries need visual/manual review.
Image content and dynamically cropped hero imagery were not pixel-sampled.
This measures computed CSS colors, not complete WCAG conformance or assistive technology behavior.
Only desktop 1440x1100 was measured; mobile/tablet sizing and zoom are outside this pass.
Default theme has no data-theme attribute; final capture treated missing attribute as light before toggling. The result records actual rendered theme on each scan.

findings.finding: Visible keyboard-shortcut hint is low contrast.
Close glyph has low contrast against its button surface; evaluated as a non-text UI symbol.
White text overlays on image/gradient; computed CSS alone cannot establish actual contrast.
